alt.en: A large teal-gridded weights cube stands at the center of a gray floor. To its left a page with a violet header is joined to it by a dotted gray line; in front, a dashed orange line runs from a dashed-outline packet to the cube; to its right a violet line with an arrow leads to a half-filled dial.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一个带青绿色网格的大型权重方块。左侧一页带紫色页眉的文件以灰色点线与它相连；前方一个虚线轮廓的数据包以橙色虚线连到方块；右侧一条带箭头的紫色线通向指针居中的仪表盘。

caption.en: Illustration: A draft benchmark method (the page) applies a storage edit (the outlined packet) to an AI agent's stored memory (the cube) and turns what the memory subsystem notices into a score (the dial). It does not depict a tested deployment or any real memory subsystem, and it does not show that any system detects tampering.
caption.zh: 示意图：一份草案中的基准方法（文件）对 AI 智能体的存储记忆（方块）实施一项存储修改（虚线数据包），再根据记忆子系统能否察觉给出分数（仪表盘）。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不代表任何真实的记忆子系统，不表明任何系统能够检测到篡改。
